note: The home planet: the hand-built port town on the sand. town names an authored town instead of a generated one, laid out by town_layout (issue #237: a saved layout in content/core/towns/, at its town_size), and world an authored world (content/core/worlds/), so nothing about the port changes. See docs/planets/PLANETS.md.

body.note: How the home ball looks from a neighbour's sky (the moon's): a smooth ball with its dunes baked flat into a print, the same dunes you walk on. relief: the print (tools/planets/bake_relief.gd writes it; re-run when the dunes change). relief_tilt steepens its slopes so they read from kilometres off; relief_crest lightens the crests.

natives.note: Issue #96: the dune people in one friendly and one hostile pack, and sand pigs. Each pack has a camp (where it starts, a stop after route point 'stop_after', and where it sleeps). Routes and camps are map points (metres along the ground from the port). locals_say: what the port's locals, calm, say of the packs when you walk close by (src/systems/npc/townsfolk.gd); an [audio tag] is voiced, never shown. The friendly Red Wind roam about 1 km out, by the near outpost. Planet layout spread: the hostile Bone Teeth were moved 7.6 km out north-north-east, into the open between two mountains, nearly 3 km from the nearest outpost (out of the troopers' sight, so no fighting yet); their loop kept its shape, turned round the ball. Sand pigs: three herds, one round the port, one round the racers' outpost on the Basin Run and one round the barge's mooring (20 in all, as before).
locals_say: I got a great deal from the Red Wind.
If you can survive the nomads, they're rather friendly... [scared] sometimes too friendly.

barge.note: Issue #269: this planet's party barge (content/core/barges/party_barge.json has the numbers every barge shares; any of them can be set here). name is the barge's, boss.name its owner's; home is a map point (metres along the ground from the port): planet layout spread: 7 km out south-east, on the open flats between the port and the far side, well past the barge's draw_m from the town.
barge.name: the Gilded Wallow

beast.note: The home planet's beast (content/core/hazards/beast.json has the numbers every beast shares; any of them can be set here too). name is what the locals call it; home is a map point (metres along the ground from the port): planet layout spread: 8.8 km out west-north-west, the emptiest stretch of the planet, out where the locals' 'far flats' are; lore is what the locals say of it, in passing and to anyone who asks.
beast.name: Old Murk
lore: Stay off the far flats. Old Murk crawls out there.
Old Murk took a whole caravan once. Walked right over it on all those legs.
If you hear something like a wet raspberry out in the sand, run.
Don't shoot at Old Murk. It remembers, and it follows.
Nobody's ever killed Old Murk. Plenty have tried. You can tell by the smell.
Old Murk doesn't hunt. It just goes where it likes, clicking those jaws, and you'd best not be there.
lore_slain: They say someone killed Old Murk. I'll believe it when I smell it gone.
Old Murk's dead, they're saying. The far flats feel wrong without it.
